lessons_used: Helpful changes: Adoption visual and photo enhancements (style selectors, pre-upload inspection screens, compact photo grids, quality callouts), split-view path layouts, wait progress tip carousels and setup checklists, background readiness hints, session reset safeguard hints, post-waiting auth reorders, and compact welcome dashboard redesigns significantly improved performance.

Hurt performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts, path copy changes (flexibility, minimalist), story scroll intros, instant path activation incentives, interactive sound and visual wait progress, pre-certificate sign-in reordering, and most desktop finish guidance banners, spotlight flows, or video cards hurt conversion.

No clear effect seen: Audio or background notifications, standard account sync and persistence flows, waiting time indicators or overlay hints, companion archetype flows, adoption incentive badges, full bleed welcome redesigns, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.

Predictions were too low: Pre-upload style inspections, photo quality callouts, compact welcome dashboard redesigns, session safeguard hints, background readiness hints, post-waiting auth stage reorders, and wait progress checklists or tip carousels performed better than expected.

Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, split-view story intros, pre-certificate sign-in reorders, instant activation highlights, and all tests that resulted in negative performance or no clear effect were overpredicted.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Spawn Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the final home welcome view into a stage-based visual desktop spawn screen that clearly showcases the active pet.
candidates.why: The finish step drops off significantly to 69% conversion with long mean times (5815s) and 3 support emails reported desktop visibility issues.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a preview cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Quick Setup Checklist Screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen called new_desktop_controls after home intro that guides users through hiding, showing, and interacting with their desktop companion.
candidates.why: Support received 3 separate complaints about users not knowing how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.

new_desktop_controls.headline: Quick Desktop Controls
new_desktop_controls.body: Learn how to summon, minimize, and speak with your pet anytime from your desktop toolbar.

guard.reason: Adds a valid controls quick setup screen after home_intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: New screens and finish guidance flows consistently hurt conversion in historical tests.

candidates.title: Photo Style Verification & Live Preview Stage Flow
candidates.change: Introduce an extra verification screen new_photo_verify during adoption to let users inspect and adjust photo style options before generation starts.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted custom pet creation failures or incorrect companion visual rendering, and adoption mean time is high at 1017s.

new_photo_verify.headline: Verify Companion Style & Framing
new_photo_verify.body: Review your pet render preview before final generation.

guard.reason: Introduces a valid verification screen during onboarding without skipping steps.

candidates.score_note: Photo style verification and inspections performed better than expected despite new screen overhead.

candidates.title: Post-Waiting Auth Stage Shift Flow
candidates.change: Reorder the sign_in screen to take place right after waiting completes so users generate their pet before authenticating.
candidates.why: 8 support emails mentioned losing pets upon sign-in reset; placing authentication after waiting protects generation progress.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in after waiting is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Post-waiting auth reorders address explicit support complaints and were proven helpful and underpredicted.

candidates.title: Account Re-Login Pet Sync Safeguard Hint
candidates.change: Display a explicit hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that signing into their original account restores saved companions.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your original account to instantly restore your existing pet and progress.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful sign-in hint without violating fair design or pricing rules.

candidates.score_note: Session reset safeguard hints significantly improved performance and directly address user complaints.

candidates.title: Desktop Environment Readiness Progress & Tip Checklist
candidates.change: Display an active setup checklist and live tip carousel on the waiting screen while pet assets render.
candidates.why: The waiting stage takes a median 201s / mean 2336s, leading to abandonment or app stalls.

waiting.hint: Preparing desktop engine and rendering companion models...

guard.reason: Adds progress and tip information to the waiting screen as allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Wait progress tip carousels and setup checklists were strongly helpful and underpredicted.

candidates.title: Compact Grid Path Selection Screen Layout
candidates.change: Change the choose_path screen layout to compact grid style to present preset and custom paths cleanly side-by-side.
candidates.why: The initial path decision has a high mean duration of 514s, indicating decision paralysis during path selection.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Create Your Pet
choose_path.body: Select a fast preset or customize your companion from custom photos.

guard.reason: Grid layout still offers both preset adoption and custom photos.

candidates.score_note: Path selection layout improvements show consistent positive lift (+2.3% measured).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Companion Identity Badge
candidates.change: Add an official companion identity seal badge on the adoption certificate screen to confirm pet registration success.
candidates.why: Builds user commitment and visual confirmation before waiting for long background rendering.

guard.reason: Adds an official verification badge to the adoption certificate screen.

candidates.score_note: Adoption incentive badges showed no clear effect or slight negative impact in past iterations.

candidates.title: Clear Desktop Controls Assistance Headline Copy
candidates.change: Update the home intro headline and body text to clearly explain desktop click and context menu controls.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets from users confused about how to hide, open, or control their pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Click your pet anytime to chat, or right-click to access controls and settings.

guard.reason: Updates home_intro text inside onboarding without affecting external screens.

candidates.score_note: Finish stage copy changes and desktop finish guidance banners historically hurt performance.

candidates.title: Desktop Render Completion System Notification Prompt
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification alerts on the waiting screen when companion generation finishes.
candidates.why: Waiting takes over 35 minutes on average, causing users to minimize the app and miss completion.

waiting.body: We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to spawn.

guard.reason: Adds completion notification settings on the waiting screen as permitted.

candidates.score_note: Home notifications showed modest positive measured lift despite mixed background notification lessons.
